_comment: Copy to apps/<slug>/handles/<handle>/narrators/<narrator>/narrator.json. An original synthetic narrator: a voice for faceless and mascot videos, with no face and no casting. Written by character-voice in narrator mode. A new voice is a new version (versions/v<n>.json keeps the old one). Never a clone of a real person, never a credential, never a lived experience it does not have. Used only where no human face is on screen.
version_note: <what changed, and the user's approval with the date>
voice_design: <how the voice was made: the tool and the text description of the voice; never a clip of a real person>
natural_voice_check: <date and result on the sample: natural breaths, varied pauses, no 2 s window under 5 semitones, room sound, no flat TTS cadence>
